outcome: aggravation of KTS-related symptoms during pregnancy
cohort: Adult women with Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome (KTS) who participated in an online survey about their obstetric history.
finding: Women with KTS have a significantly higher risk of venous thromboembolic events and a higher tendency for severe postpartum haemorrhage and aggravation of KTS symptoms during pregnancy and in the early postpartum period compared to the general population.
cross-section timing: Data was collected via an online survey on obstetric history from adult women with KTS, covering their past pregnancies.
